name: Waynflete Summer Camp
description_short: Summer camp program run by Waynflete school in Portland, Maine, offering weekly camp sessions over seven weeks for ages 4–16. Options include sports, performing arts, nature, STEM and coding, arts, Dungeons & Dragons, and a Counselor-in-Training program.

open_questions: Waynflete Summer is about ten separate camp lines (Mini Flyers, Flyers, Performing Arts, Eco Explorers, Sports, STEM, D&D, Arts, Bonus, CIT), each with its own weekly sessions and prices. Only the Flyers weeks are listed as sessions. Keep it as one listing with Flyers as the sample, add every line's weeks, or split it?

refund_policy_summary: You pay in full or a $50 deposit per camp week at registration. The deposit is non-refundable. For 2026, withdrawals in writing before May 1 got a full refund less the deposit; from May 1 until 14 days before the session, a credit (less the deposit) toward a later Waynflete program. Withdrawals within 14 days of the start are not refunded, though serious illness or family emergencies are reviewed case by case.
